description: Peer-review records and editorial artifacts echo a real replication paper's title verbatim, so every replication phrase in the title fires on a record that is not the study. Loaded back into keyword_verdict() as pattern id EDITORIAL_ARTIFACT (filter/phrase_detection.py).

match.text_regex: ^\s*(?:review for|decision letter for|peer review #|faculty opinions recommendation of|correction to|author response)\b

measured.rationale: Ported verbatim from SciMeto's NON_SCHOLARLY_REPLICATION_CONTEXTS and in production in keyword_verdict() since Stage 2 existed. A record titled 'Decision letter for: <replication paper>' is definitionally not the study, so the rule cannot have a false positive that matters.
